_comment: remedies.py — what we tell the patient when a request is rejected (email + WhatsApp).
remedy.titulo.subir_orden: Upload the referral and you're set
remedy.titulo.foto_nitida: Upload a clearer photo of the referral and you're set
remedy.titulo.orden_a_tu_nombre: Upload the referral that's in your name and you're set
remedy.detalle.reupload: Your {nombre} request is already set up: all that's missing is the referral. Take a photo where everything is readable (including the date) and upload it here — you don't have to start over.
remedy.detalle.orden_nueva: To get a new referral you need a General practice appointment. No referral is needed to book that one.
remedy.detalle.sin_firma: The referral is missing the doctor's signature or license number. If you can, ask them to add it; if not, book a General practice appointment and they'll write you a new one.
remedy.detalle.sin_fecha: The referral has no date, so we can't tell if it's still valid. If you can, ask the doctor to add the date; if not, book a General practice appointment and they'll write you a new one.
remedy.detalle.otra_jurisdiccion: The referral you uploaded was issued in another jurisdiction and doesn't apply to this center. Book a General practice appointment: no referral needed, and they'll assess you there and issue a valid referral for this network if needed.
remedy.detalle.otro_servicio_centro: Book the appointment at {nombre} ({centro}) and use the same referral: it works as is.
remedy.detalle.otro_servicio: Book the appointment at {nombre} and use the same referral: it works as is.
remedy.detalle.otro_centro_nombrado: {nombre} is also available at {centro}. The district's centers are just a few minutes apart.
remedy.detalle.otro_centro_generico: {nombre} is also available at another center. The district's centers are just a few minutes apart.
remedy.email.horarios_libres: Open times (the link books that time for you):
